<!DOCTYPE html>

<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Alpaca Morning Walk</title>
<style>
  * { box-sizing: border-box; }
  html, body {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    margin: 0;
    overflow: hidden;
    background: #9fbfc0;
  }
  body { display: grid; place-items: center; }
  svg {
    display: block;
    width: 100vw;
    height: 100vh;
  }
  .cloud-a { animation: cloudA 24s ease-in-out infinite alternate; }
  .cloud-b { animation: cloudB 31s ease-in-out infinite alternate; }
  .cloud-c { animation: cloudC 27s ease-in-out infinite alternate; }
  .sway-left {
    transform-origin: 82px 720px;
    animation: swayLeft 4.8s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
  }
  .sway-right {
    transform-origin: 1190px 720px;
    animation: swayRight 5.6s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
  }
  .leg .upper, .leg .lower, .leg .shine {
    fill: none;
    stroke-linecap: round;
    stroke-linejoin: round;
  }
  .leg .upper { stroke: #dfc9a8; stroke-width: 24; }
  .leg .lower { stroke: #d2b694; stroke-width: 12; }
  .leg .shine { stroke: #fff2d9; stroke-width: 5; opacity: .32; }
  .leg .knee { fill: #d8bf9e; }
  .leg.far { opacity: .84; }
  .leg.far .upper { stroke: #bda787; stroke-width: 20; }
  .leg.far .lower { stroke: #b49c7e; stroke-width: 10; }
  .leg.far .knee { fill: #b8a080; }
  .leg .hoof-shape { fill: #786653; }
  .leg.far .hoof-shape { fill: #887560; }
  .leg .toe-line {
    fill: none;
    stroke: #51483e;
    stroke-width: 1.2;
    stroke-linecap: round;
    opacity: .42;
  }
  @keyframes cloudA {
    from { transform: translateX(-16px); }
    to   { transform: translateX(30px); }
  }
  @keyframes cloudB {
    from { transform: translateX(18px); }
    to   { transform: translateX(-28px); }
  }
  @keyframes cloudC {
    from { transform: translateX(-8px); }
    to   { transform: translateX(20px); }
  }
  @keyframes swayLeft {
    from { transform: rotate(-1.3deg); }
    to   { transform: rotate(1.6deg); }
  }
  @keyframes swayRight {
    from { transform: rotate(1.2deg); }
    to   { transform: rotate(-1.5deg); }
  }
</style>

<script>
(() => {
  "use strict";

  const TAU = Math.PI * 2;
  const period = 1.75;
  const duty = 0.62;
  const stride = 72;
  const groundSpeed = stride / (period * duty);

  const body = document.getElementById("bodyMotion");
  const tail = document.getElementById("tailAssembly");
  const head = document.getElementById("headMotion");
  const ear = document.getElementById("nearEar");
  const charm = document.getElementById("collarCharm");
  const shadow = document.getElementById("bodyShadow");
  const ground = document.getElementById("groundScroll");
  const eye = document.getElementById("eye");
  const eyeGlint = document.getElementById("eyeGlint");

  function readLeg(id) {
    const el = document.getElementById(id);
    const d = el.dataset;
    return {
      el,
      x: Number(d.x),
      y: Number(d.y),
      phase: Number(d.phase),
      bend: Number(d.bend),
      l1: Number(d.l1),
      l2: Number(d.l2),
      ground: Number(d.ground),
      lift: Number(d.lift),
      upper: el.querySelector(".upper"),
      lower: el.querySelector(".lower"),
      shine: el.querySelector(".shine"),
      knee: el.querySelector(".knee"),
      hoof: el.querySelector(".hoof"),
      contact: document.getElementById("shadow-" + id)
    };
  }

  const legs = [
    readLeg("hindFar"),
    readLeg("frontFar"),
    readLeg("hindNear"),
    readLeg("frontNear")
  ];

  const fixed = n => n.toFixed(2);

  function poseLeg(leg, time, sway, bob) {
    const p = ((time / period + leg.phase) % 1 + 1) % 1;
    let offset;
    let lift = 0;
    let hoofAngle = 0;

    if (p < duty) {
      const q = p / duty;
      offset = stride * 0.5 - stride * q;
    } else {
      const q = (p - duty) / (1 - duty);
      offset = -stride * 0.5 + stride * q;
      lift = Math.sin(Math.PI * q) * leg.lift;
      hoofAngle = -12 * Math.sin(Math.PI * q);
    }

    const hipX = leg.x + sway;
    const hipY = leg.y + bob;
    const footX = leg.x + offset;
    const footY = leg.ground - lift - 6;
    const ankleX = footX - 2;
    const ankleY = footY - 3;

    const dx = ankleX - hipX;
    const dy = ankleY - hipY;
    const rawDistance = Math.max(0.001, Math.hypot(dx, dy));
    const distance = Math.min(rawDistance, leg.l1 + leg.l2 - 0.01);
    const ux = dx / rawDistance;
    const uy = dy / rawDistance;

    const a = (leg.l1 * leg.l1 - leg.l2 * leg.l2 + distance * distance) /
              (2 * distance);
    const h = Math.sqrt(Math.max(0, leg.l1 * leg.l1 - a * a));

    const baseX = hipX + a * ux;
    const baseY = hipY + a * uy;
    const kneeX = baseX + leg.bend * h * (-uy);
    const kneeY = baseY + leg.bend * h * ux;

    const upperPath = `M${fixed(hipX)} ${fixed(hipY)} L${fixed(kneeX)} ${fixed(kneeY)}`;
    const lowerPath = `M${fixed(kneeX)} ${fixed(kneeY)} L${fixed(ankleX)} ${fixed(ankleY)}`;

    leg.upper.setAttribute("d", upperPath);
    leg.lower.setAttribute("d", lowerPath);
    if (leg.shine) leg.shine.setAttribute("d", upperPath);

    leg.knee.setAttribute("cx", fixed(kneeX));
    leg.knee.setAttribute("cy", fixed(kneeY));
    leg.hoof.setAttribute(
      "transform",
      `translate(${fixed(footX)} ${fixed(footY)}) rotate(${fixed(hoofAngle)})`
    );

    leg.contact.setAttribute("cx", fixed(footX));
    leg.contact.setAttribute("rx", fixed(11 + lift * 0.12));
    leg.contact.setAttribute("opacity", fixed(Math.max(0.012, 0.13 - lift * 0.0052)));
  }

  function update(time) {
    const w = TAU * time / period;
    const sway = 1.15 * Math.sin(w);
    const bob = 2.15 * Math.sin(2 * w) - 0.55;

    body.setAttribute("transform", `translate(${fixed(sway)} ${fixed(bob)})`);

    const tailAngle = 6.5 * Math.sin(w - 0.55) + 1.4 * Math.sin(2 * w);
    tail.setAttribute(
      "transform",
      `translate(${fixed(sway)} ${fixed(bob)}) rotate(${fixed(tailAngle)} 486 359)`
    );

    const headAngle = 1.15 * Math.sin(w + 0.5) + 0.3 * Math.sin(2 * w);
    head.setAttribute("transform", `rotate(${fixed(headAngle)} 765 246)`);
    ear.setAttribute("transform", `rotate(${fixed(1.7 * Math.sin(w - 0.8))} 789 192)`);
    charm.setAttribute("transform", `rotate(${fixed(7 * Math.sin(w + 0.4))} 746 298)`);

    legs.forEach(leg => poseLeg(leg, time, sway, bob));

    shadow.setAttribute("cx", fixed(645 + sway * 0.45));
    shadow.setAttribute("rx", fixed(185 + bob * 1.7));

    const offset = (time * groundSpeed) % 640;
    ground.setAttribute("transform", `translate(${fixed(-offset)} 0)`);

    const blinkTime = time % 6.1;
    let blink = 0;
    if (blinkTime > 5.75 && blinkTime < 6.0) {
      blink = Math.sin((blinkTime - 5.75) / 0.25 * Math.PI);
    }
    eye.setAttribute("ry", fixed(6.2 * (1 - 0.91 * blink)));
    eyeGlint.setAttribute("opacity", fixed(1 - blink));
  }

  update(0);
  const start = performance.now();

  function frame(now) {
    update((now - start) / 1000);
    requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  }

  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
})();
</script>
